arguments.query: SELECT b.booking_id, b.status, b.request_id, b.flight_id, b.passenger_id, b.amount_cents, h.flight_id as hold_flight, c.booking_id as charge_booking FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN holds h ON b.booking_id = h.booking_id LEFT JOIN charges c ON b.booking_id = c.booking_id WHERE b.status = "pending" ORDER BY b.booking_id LIMIT 20

SELECT c.charge_id, c.booking_id, c.amount_cents, c.status, c.idempotency_key FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id IN ("bkg_7e9c5c467d785aafb2ef006a4e11d192", "bkg_8e0c6768232051e6949e5d89df9aa761", "bkg_ade3ea72db235a2b9bea7f373d293be7", "bkg_d7f779e3ccda56a4afdfdf5cea698b56")
SELECT * FROM charges WHERE booking_id IN ("bkg_8e0c6768232051e6949e5d89df9aa761", "bkg_ade3ea72db235a2b9bea7f373d293be7", "bkg_d7f779e3ccda56a4afdfdf5cea698b56") LIMIT 10
SELECT * FROM outbox ORDER BY event_id LIMIT 20
SELECT COUNT(*) as count, b.status FROM bookings b GROUP BY b.status

SELECT b.booking_id, b.status, COUNT(c.charge_id) as charge_count FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN charges c ON b.booking_id = c.booking_id WHERE b.status = "confirmed" GROUP BY b.booking_id HAVING charge_count = 0 LIMIT 10
SELECT COUNT(*) as count, c.state FROM charges c GROUP BY c.state
SELECT c.charge_id, c.booking_id, b.status FROM charges c JOIN bookings b ON c.booking_id = b.booking_id WHERE c.state = "lost"
SELECT r.*, b.status FROM refunds r JOIN bookings b ON r.booking_id = b.booking_id WHERE b.status = "confirmed"
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bookings b WHERE b.status = "confirmed" AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM holds h WHERE h.booking_id = b.booking_id) LIMIT 10
